mechanicsObserved: Guard grants +17% shared Highlight gauge, the same as any counted action (0 to 17 to 34 to 51 across the T1 guards).

True Desire: pressed at T1 (button vanished); the Alt button was next visible at the start of T10 (Actions 37) and not at T3 through T9; pressed again at T18 and not visible at B3 or B4. Consistent with 8 J&C counted actions (or 8 rounds), not 8 party actions.

Pre-break score with Life Sustainment on stopped at exactly 401,445, the same figure as Sleepy's run. Base Damage Points 405,499 in both runs. Reading: boss max HP 405,499 and the lock floor is 1% of max HP (4,054), not 1 HP.
The S3 that opened the break added only the remaining pre-break HP (401,445 to 405,499); no weakened points were credited during that action. Score at the start of B1 was 405,499.
Weakened Turns Left stayed at 2 through both Concert rounds and went 2 to 1 after the boss action following B3; B3 and B4 were the weakened turns.
Virtual Concert start healed the party (Berry 1,633 to 5,133 at T6).
MIKU song advances to the next song after each MIKU skill use; H cycles it manually (Spring Storm to Play-With-Fire to Heaven).
Feel the Beat and Clear Sound were available again on the next normal turn after use (4-action cooldown).
Marian's three skills were all available at B3 despite S3 at T18 and S2 at B1 and S1 at B2 (Concert rounds and the reset).
Berry's T1 S1 on a minion chained through all four Daisoujou by its kill-reset and then the boss; score after T1 was 362,043 (76,743 opening Two Masks + 285,300).

deviationsFromRoute: T7 Wonder Media (Vasuki) instead of Guard; T11 MIKU Clear Sound on Heaven and Wonder Media; T13 Wonder Media; T8 Defender Tonic; T13 and T15 Takemedic-All V instead of DOT-Up (pre-break damage is capped, so no score cost).

B2 Wonder Tarukaja (Dionysus) instead of Matarukaja (not on Joker's Janosik); B2 DOT-Up skipped (no prescription left); B4 Fighter Salve skipped (none left and only one owned); no A6 press at B3 (button not available).
T3 and T18 MIKU song changes: Heaven at T16 reached by two H presses.
